title: Stop the leak
hook: Keep sensitive data from walking out the door, whether it leaves by USB, email, Teams or an AI prompt.

title: Watch the insider
hook: Spot risky behavior early and tighten the controls before the damage is done.

title: Investigate and respond
hook: When something goes wrong: find it, prove it, contain it, and clean it up with a record to show for it.

title: Prove compliance
hook: Turn regulation into evidence: assessments, retention and records that stand up in front of an auditor.

title: Know your data
hook: You cannot protect what you cannot see. Map it, classify it, catalog it, and learn to trust it.
